correctness.rationale: Exactly four cyclic domain walls means 2*C(n,4) spin states. The two-point value is a hypergeometric Krawtchouk sum; its quartic polynomial in q=t(n-t) and cyclic Laplacian give lambda_0=(n-4)/5 and lambda_k=4((n^2-3n+8)u-6)/((n-1)(n-2)(n-3)u^2) for nonzero modes. Its unimodal u dependence plus global inequalities and the inspected rational-interval verifier certify integer extremal threshold switches n=8 and n=12; an independent enumeration over all four-wall subsets for n=5..15 reproduced every covariance Fourier eigenvalue and all extremal indices (including tie n=8). Positive eigenvalues and the even-n formula (n-4)(n-3)/20 follow as stated. Finite checks only test derivation and boundary, not substitute for inequalities.
residual_risks: Finite numerical/enumerative independent tests are corroboration; infinite quantifiers use the analytic proof.
